name: Budi Santoso
quotes: Gue cuma butuh yang simpel — buka, tulis, selesai.
Sticky note di monitor udah penuh, butuh yang digital.

mustHave: Bisa langsung pakai tanpa sign up
Loading cepat — kalau lambat langsung close

bookingBehaviour.decisionTiming: Langsung — kalau ingat harus catat, langsung buka app
bookingBehaviour.dropOffTrigger: Form terlalu panjang atau harus scroll untuk submit
bookingBehaviour.bookingStyle: Quick capture — judul dulu, detail nanti
bookingBehaviour.priceRange: Free — belum mau bayar untuk task manager

feedbackHistory.scoreReason: Bersih, langsung keliatan task mana yang penting. Filter-nya gampang.
feedbackHistory.firstImpression: Wah, rapi. Langsung tau mana yang harus dikerjain hari ini.
likes: Badge prioritas warna-warni — langsung keliatan mana yang urgent
Task count di atas — tau progress tanpa hitung manual
missing: Nggak ada due date warning kalau sudah dekat
feedbackHistory.wouldTheyProceed: Iya, ini yang gue cari. Simpel tapi informatif.
feedbackHistory.topChange: Tambahin indikator kalau due date hari ini atau besok.

feedbackHistory.scoreReason: Form-nya cukup simpel. Tapi pengen bisa submit lebih cepat.
likes: Priority selector yang visual — nggak perlu dropdown
missing: Quick-add mode — ketik judul aja, priority default medium
feedbackHistory.wouldTheyProceed: Iya, cuma kadang pengen yang lebih cepat.
feedbackHistory.topChange: Bikin quick-add — satu field, enter, done.

feedbackHistory.scoreReason: Detail lengkap, bisa mark done langsung. Delete ada konfirmasi — bagus.
feedbackHistory.firstImpression: Semua info ada di satu tempat. Nggak perlu back-and-forth.
likes: Toggle complete yang besar dan satisfying
Delete punya konfirmasi — nggak takut salah hapus
Priority dan due date keliatan jelas
missing: Belum bisa edit inline — harus ke halaman lain
feedbackHistory.wouldTheyProceed: Iya, ini halaman yang paling sering dibuka kayaknya.
feedbackHistory.topChange: Inline edit biar nggak perlu navigasi ke form terpisah.

feedbackHistory.scoreReason: Bagus buat weekly review. Tapi pengen lihat trend mingguan.
feedbackHistory.firstImpression: Oh ada stats-nya juga! Nggak expect tapi suka.
likes: Completed vs pending — langsung tau progress
Priority breakdown bikin sadar kalau kebanyakan 'high'
feedbackHistory.wouldTheyProceed: Iya, bakal cek ini tiap Jumat sore.
feedbackHistory.topChange: Tambahin completion rate dan mini chart trend 7 hari terakhir.

feedbackHistory.scoreReason: Stats are readable on mobile but the charts feel cramped. I'd want to see a weekly streak view too.
feedbackHistory.firstImpression: Looks clean but I have to squint at the numbers.
feedbackHistory.wouldTheyProceed: Yes, but would want the charts a bit bigger.
feedbackHistory.topChange: Add a weekly streak counter — I need motivation to keep tasks consistent.

feedbackHistory.scoreReason: On desktop the stats breathe — I can see everything at a glance without scrolling.
feedbackHistory.firstImpression: Feels like a proper dashboard when I have the full width.
likes: No need to scroll for the summary
missing: Export button to download stats as CSV
feedbackHistory.wouldTheyProceed: Definitely. This is where I'd actually review my week.
feedbackHistory.topChange: Add an export-to-CSV button — I want to track my productivity in a spreadsheet.

feedbackHistory.scoreReason: As an admin reviewing multiple users' stats, I'd want filters and sorting but the base data is all there.
feedbackHistory.firstImpression: Looks like a personal stats page, not an admin dashboard yet.
missing: User filter to see stats per team member
feedbackHistory.wouldTheyProceed: Only for reviewing my own stats. Not ready for admin use yet.
feedbackHistory.topChange: Add a user selector so I can switch between team members' stats without navigating away.
